lines.text: The Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, and Judah and Israel will be gathered under one leader.
The LORD says to call the brothers "My people" and to rebuke the mother, for she is not His wife.
Otherwise, the LORD will make her like a desert and let her die of hunger.
She says she will return to her first husband, yet does not acknowledge the LORD gave her grain.
The LORD will destroy her vines and fig trees, making them a threshing floor devoured by beasts of the field.
